Opens your bank wherever you are.
Puts an item in your inventory. Find an item's id with ::itemsearch. Example: ::item 379 10 gives 10 lobsters.
Lists items whose name contains this word, with their ids. Example: ::itemsearch lobster.
Gives you every item with an id from the first to the last.
Clears your whole inventory. The items are gone for good.
Clears your whole bank. The items are gone for good.
Fills your bank with items, one of each id in order (for testing).
Gives you 1,000 of every kind of rune.
Gives you a set of farming tools and supplies.
Gives you everything needed to brew ale.
Gives you the runes and items for the Humidify spell.
Puts items that can be stored in your house into your bank. Type the code on its own to see the types.
Gives you the Rotten potato, a developer tool item with many options.
Shows or sets the charges on an item you wear (for example a ring or amulet).
Opens a shop by its number.
Shows what a monster would drop if you killed it that many times. Add true to put the drops in your bank.
Sets one skill to a level, 1 to 99. Example: ::setlevel woodcutting 60.
Adds experience to a skill. Example: ::addxp mining 5000.
Sets every skill back to the starting levels.
Trees fall after you cut a single log (switch it off by typing it again).
Gives you a Slayer task for that monster.
Brings a monster that ends your current Slayer task straight away.
Your Summoning familiar never runs out of special move points.
Changes your spellbook: 0 normal, 1 Ancient Magicks, 2 Lunar.
Shows how far you are in each quest, with its number. Add part of a name to show just that quest.
Sets a quest to a stage. Use ::quest to find the number. 100 usually means complete.
Opens a list of the quests the game has.
Teleports you to map coordinates. Example: ::tele 3222 3218 0 is Lumbridge. The Playground shows your coordinates at the bottom right.

Teleports you to a named place: lumbridge, varrock, falador, draynor, port sarim, rimmington, al kharid, taverley, barbarian village, grand exchange, karamja, brimhaven, shilo, yanille, ardougne, gnome stronghold, camelot, catherby, rellekka, trollheim, tzhaar, wizard tower, pest control, corp, godwars, bounty hunter or clan wars.
Teleports you to the game's home spot (Lumbridge).
Teleports you to the first object with that name in a region.
Teleports you next to the shooting star that is falling now.
You take no damage (type it again to switch it off).
You kill anything with one hit (type it again to switch it off).
Your special attack bar never runs out.
Lets monsters attack you on their own (they normally leave admins alone).
Shows the highest hit you can do now.
Shows your chance to hit a monster.
Shows your defence against a monster's melee, ranged and magic.
Kills your character (you respawn as normal).
Poisons you, starting at that much damage.
Makes a monster or person appear next to you. Add true to let it walk around. Find ids with ::npcsearch.
Lists monsters and people whose name contains this word, with their ids.
Grows all your planted crops by one stage.
Makes all your crops diseased (for practising Cure Patch).
Finishes the compost in your compost bins.
How fast pets get hungry and grow: 0 never, 1 normal, 2 very fast.
Lets you claim the star sprite's reward again.
Makes a shooting star land now.
Opens the makeover screen (change your look).
Makes you look like a monster or person (by its id from ::npcsearch).
Plays an animation on your character.
Plays a music track by number.
Shows where you are standing (x, y and floor) and more detail about the spot.
Shows the number of the map region you are in.
Lists every command in the game chat.
Finds commands that contain a word.
Closes whatever screen or dialogue is open.
Shows your active timers (poison, boosts and so on).
Draws the path your character is walking.
Shows which tiles around you can't be walked on.
Casts a harmless Ice Barrage on players nearby.
Buries your inventory here as treasure for someone to dig up.
Buries a secret message where you stand.
Starts a random event for you.
Removes your admin rights for good, so cheats stop working on this character. Don't use it unless you mean it.
Wipes the character's save completely. Make a backup first.
Resets Elemental Workshop I and takes you to its start.
Shuts the game world down straight away. Close the game window afterwards.
